cohort: The cohort consisted of 1200 women from the Ibadan Pregnancy Cohort Study in Southwest Nigeria who were not lost to follow-up, had health facility deliveries, and complete infant birthweight records.
finding: History of macrosomia, maternal obesity, and male infant sex were identified as predictors of macrosomia, which was in turn associated with an increased risk of emergency Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Macrosomia was significantly associated with an increased risk of emergency Cesarean section (RR = 1.675, 95% CI: 1.068-2.627).
birth_weight: All infants with birthweight records; macrosomia defined as >= 4 kg.
